main_text.head: PROVERBIORUM QUÆ IN HOC OPERE CITATA SUNT BREVIS RECENSIO.
main_text.p: احاديث طعم واحلامها Narrationes [seu Fabu-[le][?]] Tasmi, & Somnia eorum. دعزت لمن خبرك بها[?] pag.39. لا اصل له[?] (inquit AlMidanicnfis) Jactatur in eum qui tibi narrat illud quod nullo nititur fundamento. Valebit ergo forsan, ex ipsius sententia, Narrationes de Tasmo &c. sc. de iis quorum dudum obliterata est memoria, nec quicquam jam certi reliquum.

عند جهينة الخبر اليقين[?] Apud Jobainam certum est nuntium. Jobainab autem tribus nomen, hîc pro Jobainiensi positum. Jobainiensis autem à quo ortum ducit proverbium, perhibetur الخنس[?] Achnas quidam, qui de Hosaino quem ipse interfecerat, à quibusvis obviis sciscitanti ejus sorori, respondit,pag.38.
تسايل عن حصين كل ركب[?] ومن جهينة الخبر اليقين[?]

i.e. Interrogas de Hosaino quemlibet catnum, Atqui apud Jobainam certum est nuntium. Cujus versus hemistichium posterius in proverbium abiit, quod usurpant cum indicare velint unde certa alicujus rei notitia petenda sit; vel cum quis sibi rem penitus compertam

page.notes: The Arabic lines (in the first two paragraphs and the verse) are only partly legible at this scan resolution; I have marked the doubtful words with [?] and the word "[le]" in the catchline "Fabu-[le]" is also doubtful. The Arabic should be checked against a higher-resolution image. The title's "VV" forms were normalised to "U" per the instructions. The last line "compertam" is a full text line, not a catchword. The stamp "Digitized by Google" at bottom right is omitted.
